args: alias.unica-bootstrap=!f() { root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -n "$root" ] || root="$PWD/${GIT_PREFIX:-}"; exec sh "${root%/}/bootstrap/launch.sh" "${root%/}"; }; f
unica.note: Single public Unica stdio MCP orchestrator. The public Git package enters through a command-scoped Git shell alias, resolves the plugin root from the host, selects a native bootstrap, verifies the pinned runtime, and transparently launches unica.
